subject: Nimbus Finance — Private VPC topology options and netops action plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nimbusfin.com>; Sara Khan <sara.khan@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus Finance — post-demo recap & requested network info (Private VPC)

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on your latency targets and regulatory needs. Quick recap and concrete asks so NetOps can validate a Private VPC flow (we covered Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private; you indicated Private VPC is the preferred route).

Key constraints you mentioned:
- Data residency: primary west-us region only.
- No internet-facing endpoints inside your subnet (security requirement).
- Third-party vendor connectivity must go via approved egress IP allowlist.
- You prefer PrivateLink over classic VPC peering where possible due to org policy.

Action items for Nimbus (please share by EOD Fri):
1) Provide a short list of egress static IPs (or confirms you will accept a small NAT range).
2) Confirm whether you can accept cross-account AWS PrivateLink (we'll need an acceptor role).
3) Share your internal CIDR(s) for the subnets that will host the endpoint.
4) Any proxy / firewall rules that require specific ports other than 443.

What we (Redwood) will do:
- Aditya will draft a PrivateLink configuration checklist and minimal IAM steps.
- Karthik will double-check our runtime SNI and TLS cert behavior for your firewall team.
- I'll put together a short timeline for an initial connectivity window (approx 2–3 business days for smoke tests once we have IP/CIDR).

Attachments: short summary PDF with options (Privatelink vs Peering) and rough timeline.

Next call suggestion: 30–45 minute netops-focused session with your firewall engineer — are you available Wednesday 7/7?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nimbusfin.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Khan <sara.khan@nimbusfin.com>; Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Finance — post-demo recap & requested network info (Private VPC)

Thanks, Evelyn — good summary. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with NetOps: 

- PrivateLink preferred. Peering only if PrivateLink is impractical for the Redis/KV traffic you mentioned.
- Egress: our security policy requires a pair of static egress IPs for vendor allowlisting. We can allocate 2 IPv4 NAT IPs from our infra team.
- CIDR: we will host in 10.240.0.0/16 for the new PCI-scoped VPC. Endpoints must be in 10.240.32.0/24 or 10.240.33.0/24 (we prefer isolated /24s).
- Proxy: outbound port 443 only. No additional ports.
- On-prem: there's a separate project for hybrid, but not required for phase 1.

I'll ask NetOps to send the formal egress IPs and a contact for their firewall engineer (likely Sara). Expect that by Fri 7/2.

Also, one policy note: we will need an internal audit ticket for any cross-account role creation — that will add 24–48 hours to the schedule on our side.

Tom
Head of Infrastructure
Nimbus Finance

On Tue, Jun 29, 2027 at 14:05, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (quoted above)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nimbusfin.com>; Sara Khan <sara.khan@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Finance — post-demo recap & requested network info (Private VPC)

Appreciate the quick clarifications, Tom — this is helpful. A few practical notes from a deployment perspective so your NetOps can validate feasibility before we schedule the connectivity window:

1) PrivateLink flow we typically use (high level):
   - Redwood creates a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in our account fronting the model-serving fleet.
   - We share a vpc endpoint service name; your team creates an interface endpoint in the Nimbus VPC (the endpoint gets ENIs in the chosen /24).
   - Once accepted, traffic goes over AWS private network; TLS endpoint is terminated at the NLB (mutual TLS optional).

2) Egress allowlist: if you can provide the two static NAT IPs that’s perfect — we will whitelist those for callbacks and billing webhooks. If you cannot provide static IPs we can explore a small documented CIDR but that will require a peering-style NAT path which you said is disfavored.

3) IAM/acceptance: for interface endpoints we will need your team to accept the service (console or accept-role). We can provide a CloudFormation snippet or a manual click flow — which does NetOps prefer?

4) Security scan & certs: Karthik, can you confirm our TLS setup and whether we should prepare for mTLS with client certs?

Proposed next steps (short):
- Tom/Sara to confirm the two egress IPs + pick one /24 (by 7/2).
- Aditya to share PrivateLink checklist & CFN by 7/3.
- Karthik to propose a test window (we suggest 7/8–7/9) pending audit approval.

I attached a one-page checklist (redwood-privatelink-config-checklist.xlsx) and a PDF we used in the demo. If helpful I can open a short shared doc to capture the step-by-step runbook during the netops call.

Thanks — cc'ing Karthik for the cert/mTLS note.

— Aditya
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>; Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>; Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nimbusfin.com>
Cc: Sara Khan <sara.khan@nimbusfin.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus Finance — post-demo recap & requested network info (Private VPC)

Quick engineering note:

- TLS: default is TLS termination at the NLB with SNI preserved. We support mutual TLS; if you require mTLS we'll need to exchange certs and coordinate rotation windows. If NetOps prefers mTLS, please include the cert owner and rotation cadence in the runbook.
- Healthchecks: our NLB healthchecks are TCP/443 by default; if your firewall restricts probes we can switch to an HTTP(S) path.
- Latency: with PrivateLink in us-west-2 we typically see 6–12ms RTT for model forward+response for the model profile discussed; we will baseline during the test window.
- Cross-account IAM: We can provide a CloudFormation snippet to create the acceptance principal to speed up the audit ticket. If your policy forbids cross-account roles, we can still do a manual accept flow but it will be slower.

I attached a short CSV with the minimal port/probe checklist and the RedTeam test steps (filename stub: nimbus_network_constraints_summary.pdf). Once we have the egress IPs and chosen /24 I can prepare the endpoint and reserve the tests.

Proposed meeting: I can join the netops session Wed 7/7 at 9:00am PT if that works. If NetOps prefers after audit clear then aim for 7/8–7/9 as Aditya suggested.

Karthik Iyer
Engineering (Deployments)
Redwood Inference
